@Lekensteyn @johnthacker some idea ? (not an expert of pytest...)

There's a lot of errors:

```
 wsutil/wmem/wmem_core.c:38 -- wmem_alloc(): assertion failed: allocator->in_scope
```

So that implies to me that `wmem_file_scope()` or `wmem_packet_scope()` is being used during dissector registration, when there isn't a file or packet open.
Thanks @johnthacker . Fixed it.

added 1 commit
  • 94684a7f - Add parsing support for IWbemServices and WMIO
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13858/diffs?diff_id=883952644&start_sha=d661b5b3ae67ca43e6e3cff14523e3bb10e45a29)

You can't call `dcom_register_routine` during handoff.

Look at how some of the other dissectors, like `packet-dcom-sysact.c`, use it. They call it before dissection and register on a lazy basis. (If it's already registered, it does nothing.)

Possibly the DCOM dissector could be rewritten to register those at program startup using `wmem_epan_scope()` instead, but the lazy initialization seems fine (and saves on memory if files don't have any DCOM.)

changed this line in [version 6 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13858/diffs?diff_id=886037362&start_sha=94684a7f298a6c97991dcb353cb8f57dc71fedb7#e0df2cc8391b6bcfe0e67b155df77f7b67a05697_1241_1239)
